title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: Mika would like to estimate how far she can ride a new model of electric bike on a fully charged battery. She completed two trips totaling \(40\) miles. The first trip used \(\frac{1}{2}\) of the total battery power, while the second trip used \(\frac{3}{10}\) of the total battery power. How many miles can this electric bike go on a fully charged battery?

solutions.text: The two trips used \(\frac12+\frac3{10}=\frac45\) of a full battery. Since \(\frac45\) of the range is \(40\) miles, a full charge gives \(40\div\frac45=50\) miles.
hints: Add the fractions of battery used on the two trips
\(40\) miles is \(\frac45\) of a full charge
